from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh

    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape

    # Validate
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts must be finite")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts must be nonnegative")
    if np.any(np.sum(counts, axis=1) == 0):
        raise ValueError("All-zero cell rows not allowed")
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells-1")

    # IDF scaling
    df = np.count_nonzero(counts, axis=0)
    idf = np.log(n_cells / (1.0 + df))
    X = counts * idf

    # Row normalize
    row_norms = np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_norms[row_norms == 0] = 1
    X = X / row_norms

    # Matrix-free operator for X X^T
    def matvec(v):
        return X @ (X.T @ v)

    n = X.shape[0]
    op = LinearOperator((n, n), matvec=matvec, dtype=X.dtype)

    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.randn(n).astype(X.dtype)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(op, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=v0)

    # Convert to eigenvalues of W = X X^T - I
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues - 1

    # Sort descending
    idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[idx]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, idx]

    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors

from scipy.sparse.linalg import LinearOperator, eigsh

    n_cells, n_features = counts.shape

    # Validate
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts must be finite")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts must be nonnegative")
    if np.any(np.sum(counts, axis=1) == 0):
        raise ValueError("All-zero cell rows not allowed")
    if not (1 <= n_components < n_cells):
        raise ValueError("n_components must be between 1 and n_cells-1")

    # IDF scaling
    df = np.count_nonzero(counts, axis=0)
    idf = np.log(n_cells / (1.0 + df))
    X = counts * idf

    # Row normalize
    row_norms = np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    row_norms[row_norms == 0] = 1
    X = X / row_norms

    # Compute degree vector matrix-free: d = X @ (X.T @ 1) - 1
    ones = np.ones(n_cells)
    d = X @ (X.T @ ones) - 1.0
    d = np.maximum(d, 1e-12)  # avoid division by zero
    sqrt_d_inv = 1.0 / np.sqrt(d)

    # Matrix-free operator for S = D^{-1/2} (X X^T - I) D^{-1/2}
    def matvec(v):
        u = sqrt_d_inv * v
        temp = X @ (X.T @ u)
        return sqrt_d_inv * (temp - u)

    n = X.shape[0]
    op = LinearOperator((n, n), matvec=matvec, dtype=X.dtype)

    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
    v0 = rng.randn(n).astype(X.dtype)
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(op, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=v0)

    # Sort descending
    idx = np.argsort(eigenvalues)[::-1]
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[idx]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, idx]

    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
